title: Archi
description: An ArchiMate 3.2 modeller in the manner of Archi: the model tree, the open view drawn with Archi's figures and edited with archi-online's editor, the properties of what is selected with their Analysis, the Visualiser, and Archi's Specializations Manager, Properties Manager and Find and Replace, and an Agent panel that asks the person's agent and previews what it proposes in the editor, over Archi.nendo's record types.
